title: Philosophy as handmaid; plunder the Egyptians
english: Take from Greek learning what serves the interpretation of the holy Scriptures — as Israel once took Egyptian goods for the tabernacle — but do not stay in Egypt. Philosophy is a handmaid if it leads to Christ; a mistress if it [[takes you captive >> Bible:Colossians 2:8]].
translator_notes: Copy-text: Africanus = First1K/Perseus TEI tlg2042.tlg045; Gregory = Robinson Philocalia 13 TEI. No ANF 4 Crombie wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Ask, seek, knock — GREGORY CLOSEOUT SERIES CLOSEOUT
english: Above all, attend to the reading of the divine Scriptures with prayer. [[Ask, and it will be given; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened >> Bible:Matthew 7:7]]. Bring your trained mind as an offering, and let the Word be the end of the journey. GREGORY CLOSEOUT. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
